# Direct backend bootstrap oracle contracts

The four exact inherited lifecycle originals are unchanged CV0.33.0 tests.
original_lifecycle_oracle.py executes them with Python assertions enabled, records
actual interpreter/module/test hashes and separately measures backend factory,
exact fetcher/component identities, private owner and explicit close authority.
The unused requests_mock plugin is disabled to avoid its unrelated urllib3 IPv6
probe; no required fixture/provider branch is skipped. No original performs
network I/O. Supplemental probes are not additional original functions.

same_bytes_oracle.py accepts actual native-exported CMS/content/candidate evidence
and matching native stdout output receipts. It performs fresh validation of those
SAME bytes with explicit roots and clock; it never regenerates native signatures.
Exact low-level MAIN predicates and the ordinary normalizing public CMS facade
are reported separately. HTTP selection/pool/ownership remains actual native
evidence; offline candidate-material comparison is not Python HTTP transport
parity. Custom nonserialized context policies stay native-only with an explicit
comparison exclusion, not a provider skip or weakened default oracle.

Four bootstrap originals alone are eligible after independent Root integration
and complete workspace gate. Disabled behavior is supplementary; the fifth
original's actual manager predicate is not implemented here. Direct close is
neither context owner adoption nor outer operation cleanup.

Fresh execution receipts and failed harness attempts are retained under
~/.codex/artifacts/sigis/round3/s/direct-bootstrap/oracle/. No count promotion
or universal compatibility/trust claim follows from fixture generation/replay.
